Jonas — attaching the inventory and a short summary. See attachment: subprocessor_inventory_v2.xlsx

Summary (high level):
- Primary roster (TransitProxy v2): EdgeHost (EU), EdgeHost (US), CacheWave (US), TelemetryRelay (US), KeyOps (US - KMS/HSM), DataVault (onshore EU backup).
- Temporary processors: During rolling cutovers we use StreamBridge (US) for buffering; it's only used <72h and covered by our temporary-processor playbook.
- Residency: EdgeHost EU nodes keep telemetry and prefixes inside EU; CacheWave and TelemetryRelay have US egress unless onshore fallback is engaged.
- Encryption: All links use TLS1.3 in transit; at-rest encryption with AES-256 with per-tenant keys managed by KeyOps (HSM).
- Fallbacks/onshore alternatives: For EU customers we automatically route to EdgeHost (EU) primary; if EdgeHost EU loses available capacity we failover to DataVault (onshore EU) for persist/ingress and use our onshore caching partner (EdgeHost Onshore) — see the fallback matrix in sheet 'FallbackMatrix'.

Open items for legal/compliance to confirm before sending externally:
1) Latest DPA addendum with CacheWave (we have a draft from 2028-11-02).
2) Confirmation of StreamBridge temporary-use policy window (ops team to confirm SLA triggers).

If you want I can draft the external-facing matrix (one-page) and include the HubSpot/DocuSign links and the attestation we have for KeyOps.

-Marissa

Ava — thanks for the patience. Please find our consolidated matrix attached (RI_transitproxy_subprocessor_matrix_20281212.pdf). High-level answers inline below and the spreadsheet attached for drill-down.

Quick summary:
- Full roster: EdgeHost (EU/FR), EdgeHost (US/OR), CacheWave (US/CA), TelemetryRelay (US/NH), KeyOps (US/KMS-HSM), DataVault (EU/NL onshore backup), StreamBridge (US) - temporary during cutovers.
- Data transfer paths: EU customer traffic is handled in-region by EdgeHost EU by default. If onshore fallback is triggered (capacity or export control), data is persisted to DataVault EU (NL) and cached on EdgeHost Onshore. We include country-level egress flags in the attached sheet.
- Controls: TLS1.3 for transport; AES-256 with tenant-scoped keys; HSM-backed key management for long-term storage. Routine SOC2 + encryption attestations are linked.
- Fallbacks: Fallback is automatic based on capacity and export-control flags. For CloudCraft specifically we recommend a canary window (2 hours) for failover testing; ops will provide runbook excerpts.

Related artifacts:
- Evidence bundle (internal drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBz-TransitProxy-Evidence
- HubSpot ticket: hubspot://deal/DEAL-8792

1) Marissa will confirm DPA addendum status with CacheWave and send the signed excerpt.
2) Kimberly will add the StreamBridge temporary-use SLA snippet to the spreadsheet.
3) Jonas will coordinate a 60-min call with CloudCraft next week to walk the matrix and the failover runbook.

If that works, we'll aim to share the PDF + spreadsheet as the formal response and schedule the call for next Tue/Wed.
